credit.credit-words: The tone in which the upward suspension is resolved
must not exist in another voice above the suspension.
In a lower voice, this tone may exist, but not in the Alto
and not in the sixth chord.

direction-type.words: Sometimes the suspensions are wrong individually, when they are accompanied they become correct.
These suspensions can be interpreted as incomplete eleventh chord and thirteenth chord:
With chromatic modulation in a minor key, with an deceptive cadence in a major key,
with a half-cadence in a minor key, with a chromatic passing note, etc., a suspension of
a diminished octave or an augmented unison may be formed.
